scripts.clean: node -e "for (const d of ['allure-results', 'allure-report', 'test-results', 'playwright-report']) require('node:fs').rmSync(d, { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.test: npm run clean && node --env-file-if-exists=.env node_modules/@playwright/test/cli.js test
scripts.test:browserstack: npm run clean && node --env-file-if-exists=.env node_modules/browserstack-node-sdk/src/bin/runner.js playwright test --config=playwright.browserstack.config.js
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:browserstack
scripts.git:pre-commit-hook: npm run format:check && npm run lint
scripts.setup:husky: node -e "try { (await import('husky')).default() } catch (e) { if (e.code !== 'ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND') throw e }" --input-type module
scripts.report:open: npm run report && allure open allure-report
